title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 QAD on two Sparks
evidence_scope: Revision 60215d26cf5e42c2db6128774032d57fc62678da (branch qad-step5500-ple1000) with HC token-row prefill ownership, a BF16 target LM head, MXFP8 hyper-connection down/injection projections for batches of at most 16 rows, the fused rotary-embedding op, MTP drafts sampled from the draft distribution with the draft's MXFP8 experts on the humming MoE backend, and RoCEnante all-reduces for up to 64 decode rows. On installer image dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032, an installation through install.sh on one pair, adopting the checkpoint copies on the Sparks, passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, and decoded 54.6 / 202 / 296 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 3,663 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20260927-b12xcache-qwen38-flash-next-tp2-20260927.md). On installer image dev-20261001-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one pair passed the same 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate or failed response, and decoded 53.6 / 201 / 296 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 3,660 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20261001-kraken-qwen38-flash-next-tp2-20261001.md). On installer image dev-20261004-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on two Sparks of a four-Spark ring passed 7 of 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate or failed response, and decoded 52.2 / 200 / 289 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 3,630 tokens/s, medians of two runs (performance/records/images/dev-20261004-kraken-qwen38-flash-next-tp2-20261004.md). Timings on earlier images are single runs; not serving-qualified. No release qualification covers this revision. With SIRCL's ring schedules for large all-reduces, all-gathers and reduce-scatters with a 64 KiB one-shot limit and 1 MiB link pieces and slot, set at the container level; an installer deployment takes them from the pair and path-4 rows of SparkRing's default SIRCL tuning table, which apply to SIRCL 0.3.1 sessions, so on images with SIRCL 0.3.0, such as 816c6d6a7e96 and af06e2727b6a, it runs without them, on SIRCL on pairs of a ring of eight, on image 816c6d6a7e96 (lock dev-20261008-kraken-csf-sircl-libsircl-cu1342-nccl2323-status034) with GPU clocks locked at 2,418 MHz, checkpoint qad-step-4000 measured 27.0 / 92.4 and checkpoint qad-step5500-mxfp8-attention 25.6 / 89.8 decode steps/s at 1 / 8 streams through the serving A/B runner (performance/records/images/dev-20261008-kraken-csf-sircl-libsircl-tp2-tp4-matrix-20261009.md); the default checkpoint did not run there.
